generation_attempt.failure_message: Routing view differs from its native association inputs.
generation_attempt.cause: The resumed harness constructed WitnessGenerationPlan.role_evidence using an equivalent but distinct role-evidence object from the exact instance retained by the captured routing view. Production candidate-association validation requires the plan role-evidence object to be the same retained instance as the routing view role evidence. The mismatch caused generation to raise before any recipe projection executed.
